typography.hierarchy_rules: Use font weight and opacity instead of borders. The eye should naturally know where to look. Headings are 'General Sans'. Data/SPL readouts MUST use 'JetBrains Mono'. Never use bold generic sans fonts.

colors.color_rules: Reduce saturation by 30%. Never use colors for decoration. Pink is strictly for primary CTA. Green = System Healthy. Cyan = Measurements. Purple = DSP. Orange = Warnings. Use solid background colors for data-heavy sections to avoid glass refraction.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) over pure black backgrounds to simulate dark architectural spaces. 'Glassmorphism' strictly for command bar and floating nav.

grids.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard, but aggressively scaled up (p-8, p-12, p-16).
grids.dashboard_layout: ONE HERO CARD centered. No widget grid.
grids.bento_rules: If bento is needed for utilities, use high-density mode A but with soft transparent borders (border-white/5). Everything must feel like floating surfaces, not constrained boxes.

layouts.navigation: Remove permanent sidebar. Use a Raycast-style Command Bar (Cmd+K) and a minimal, floating top-nav or bottom pill for mobile. Interface should disappear.
layouts.page_structure: Progressive disclosure. Always center content with massive horizontal padding.

motion.transitions: Gentle fades, smooth transitions. Layout animations using Framer Motion (layoutId).
motion.hover_states: Soft hover animations (scale 1.02 or subtle background lighten).
motion.loading: Elegant skeleton fades, no abrupt spinners. Everything must feel expensive.

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast checks. Ensure all text over dark gray is #E4E4E7 or brighter.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the 3D stage map.

media.image_treatment: Black/white or heavily desaturated images to fit the dark architectural vibe. Max 80vh on mobile.

3d_libraries.usage: Use for the Stage Map (2D + 3D). Render with dark ambient lighting, glowing cyan/purple edges for PA speakers, avoiding realistic materials. Emphasize 'holographic' tech look over literal simulation.

architectural_dark.description: dark pathway lit with small light fixture, used for mood/texture behind AI Home

concert_stage.description: grayscale photography of stage with lights, used for library/templates card background

Information Architecture.strategy: Merge 19 routes down to 6 core flows. Eradicate 'engineering dashboard' feel.

routes./design: Merged: Room Scan -> Gear Builder -> PA Design -> DSP -> Stage Map -> Channels
routes./perform: Merged: Live SPL Meter -> Session Recording -> Kiosk FOH Mode
routes./library: Merged: Scenes -> Templates -> Community Gear DB

Information Architecture.flow: Current Project -> Primary CTA -> Progress -> Performance Summary -> Technical Details -> Utilities.

AI-First Landing Flow.landing_question: What would you like to do today?
AI-First Landing Flow.interaction: Cinematic text reveal. 5 elegant ghost cards list the objectives. Once clicked, interface morphs gracefully (framer-motion layoutId) into the unified context flow. Unnecessary tools remain hidden until called.

Hero Card Blueprint.description: ONE HERO CARD that replaces the dashboard grid.
Hero Card Blueprint.structure: Large rounded card (24px radius), soft dark gray background (bg-[#121214]). Split into three distinct optical zones. Uses typography for hierarchy. No internal borders.

states.in-progress: Progress ring, current step highlighted, secondary text indicates 'Next: Gear Builder'
states.ready: Green text '#5BA777' indicating 'System Healthy', large Pink CTA 'Go Live'

Command Bar Copilot.description: AI Operating System interface. A floating orb or Raycast-style modal (Cmd+K).
Command Bar Copilot.functionality: Navigate anywhere, answer technical questions ('optimize my subs'), perform actions ('export report').
Command Bar Copilot.visuals: Frosted glass background (backdrop-blur-2xl), 1px subtle white border (border-white/10), heavily desaturated icons.

Component Reduction Table.Sidebar: Removed entirely. Replaced by Command Bar / floating minimal nav.
Component Reduction Table.Widget_Grid: Removed. Replaced by single Hero Card.
Component Reduction Table.Tabs: Reduced. Use progressive disclosure via inline expanding sections instead of page-level tabs.
Component Reduction Table.Action_Buttons: Merged. Only one Pink CTA on screen at a time. All other actions are ghost buttons.

DO: Apply rounded corners between 18 and 24 px
Treat AI as the OS, not a widget
DONT: Do NOT resemble ArrayCalc or Smaart
Do NOT use a widget grid dashboard
Do NOT use bright, highly saturated colors
Do NOT preserve current interface out of compatibility

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
Never center align the app container in global CSS. Optical alignment over mathematical.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Use Shadcn primitives where applicable, but customize their radius to 18-24px and use dark/subtle borders.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds over content. Always use backdrop-blur.
Create depth with layered design elements, not just flat panels.
instructions_to_main_agent: Treat this as a luxury iOS/visionOS app ported to the web. Extreme restraint. The AI copilot is the core navigation paradigm. The UI should whisper, not shout. Prioritize typography and space over boxes.
